title: Fray Bentos mill northwest yard block
visualBrief: Whole independently placed northwest yard block roofed body inside Planta UPM Fray Bentos: full original 4-corner footprint, closed industrial walls and roof, base, estimated service entrances, upper louver bays and modest exposed trim. Separate process plant, chimney, tanks, conveyors, roads and yards remain separate; no whole-factory proxy. Already cleared U.S. Embassy Montevideo original photographs supply factory-level industrial material vocabulary only: light metal/concrete cladding, gray structural trim and dark louvers. They do not identify this specific hall or its roof profile, opening census, doors or attached machinery. Numerical original footprint and 2023 relative heights govern this body; no source satellite photographs, orthophotos, map images, figures or owner report imagery used. Qualla-first 26 families already screened; no rights revalidation or new imagery adopted. Automated footprint has 5 m horizontal uncertainty; numerical height at least 3 m uncertainty, not survey. Original conservative industrial details: low dual-pitch standing-seam roof, light-gray corrugated metal over low concrete base, plain gray trim/gutters/downpipes, two closed service/personnel entries and2 upper louver bays. Roof pitch, opening census, facade positions/materials/finish, function and precise2023condition unverified;3m component uncertainty. Opening heights scaled below the low eaves.
